ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Scams
ideas.description: This story would investigate the prevalence of Medicaid scams and how they are carried out. It would also examine the measures being taken to prevent and detect these scams.
questions: What measures are being taken to prevent and detect these scams?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale problem and bring attention to the need for increased oversight and monitoring of Medicaid programs. I would start by researching the latest data on Medicaid scams and interviewing experts in the field.
